edits.old: Then the system refuses the load
edits.new:
Then the system refuses the load

  Scenario: AC3 A role, team, method or cap not known is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case list fake returns LOV-ASSIGN and LOV-TEAM, and the rwb-case parameters fake returns the cap maximum
    And a queue file with a role_code, team_code, assignment_method or capacity_cap that is not known
    When it is checked
    Then the file is refused whole with 422 and MSG-P1-002, naming each row

  Scenario: AC4 A decision record that cannot be written stops the check (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the decision-record fake is forced to fail
    And a queue file that passes every check
    When it is checked
    Then the check stops with 503 and MSG-P7-003, and the owner is never called

  Scenario: AC5 An owner that does not answer keeps the check VALIDATED with its hand-off pending (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case queue fake answers the reference load with an error
    When the accepted file is handed off
    Then the state stays VALIDATED with its hand-off pending, the screen says so, and no queue version is claimed

  Scenario: AC6 A different file for the same date is a conflict (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a check exists for a file and date
    When a different file is uploaded for the same date
    Then the answer is 409 and the first check is kept
